handoff.description: Where the next run should continue: what remains, which files are half-done, and what to do first. If the run completed everything planned, say so explicitly ("nothing left; memory is tidy"). One short paragraph — the report carries the detail.

status.description: "done" when the planned work is complete; "handoff" when you are stopping early (budget, time, or a task that needs the user). Defaults to "done". This word is for your own bookkeeping — the harness decides the run's terminal status.
